summary: RPCS3 Core 621 = the delivered Core 610 plus one folded delta: the Core 612, 613, 616 and 619 records unchanged and the Core 621 changes (build-utils/rpcs3/core621-from-619.patch over Core 619): every title, a GPU timestamp pair around each RSX primary command buffer, read without waiting after its fence signalled, calibrated against the host clock (VK_EXT_calibrated_timestamps) and attributed to the session and the RSX frame, overlaps counted once (REWINDBOX_GPU_TIMING_621, COREPROF GPUTIME621 and gpu_execution_ms/cause= in FRAMECAUSE_EVENT; GPU Timing Probe setting to measure its cost); freezes as episodes on a running-time clock that stops while paused, loading or suspended, a quiet freeze included, one FREEZE_DUMP per episode with a waits summary (REWINDBOX_FREEZE_EPISODE_621, FREEZE_EPISODE begin/update/end); the mounted ISO image opened once and read by pread so renaming it during a session cannot fail a later open (REWINDBOX_ISO_IMAGE_LIFETIME_621, ISO.h newly carried); the graphics pipeline queue and the draws skipped for a program not ready (REWINDBOX_PIPELINE_QUEUE_621, COREPROF PIPEQUEUE621); from the Build 620 iPhone logs, the ZCULL on-demand lever trips on sustained guest waits only (Assassin's Creed tripped the 619 one-second budget at 401.5 ms and lost 3.4-4.3 s per 5 s to GPU syncs afterwards), Black Ops II joins it (1.1-1.9 s per 5 s of syncs), ZCULL On-Demand Reads setting, COREPROF ZCULLTRIP621, per-frame zcull_wait_ms and cause=zcull_sync (REWINDBOX_ZCULL_DEMAND_GUARD_621, REWINDBOX_ZCULL_DEMAND_BO2_621, REWINDBOX_ZCULL_FRAME_621). ABI 30, the 92 exports, the PPU/SPU codegen identities (no codegen input changes) and the MoltenVK dependency of Core 610 unchanged. Numbered 621: IPA 620 is another session's MeloNX/RetroAchievements build with Core 619.

route.note: The route keeps its Core 610 file names (workflow, gate, driver, recipe patch, core610-proof.json, core610-recipe.sh): the frozen recipe patch and the driver pins name the gate path, so the executed recipe stays byte-identical to the one Core 610 executed. Every per-build value is declared here.
